name.en: Pre-Matric Scholarship for ST Students (Classes IX & X)
name.hi: अनुसूचित जनजाति (ST) विद्यार्थियों के लिए प्री-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति (कक्षा IX और X)

shortDescription.en: Financial help for Scheduled Tribe students in Class IX and X so they stay in school and move on to higher studies.
shortDescription.hi: कक्षा IX और X में पढ़ रहे अनुसूचित जनजाति के विद्यार्थियों के लिए आर्थिक सहायता, ताकि वे पढ़ाई जारी रखें और आगे बढ़ें।

categoryRule.note: Only Scheduled Tribe students of their domicile State/UT. General, OBC, SC and other categories must not see this scholarship as applicable.

provider.ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Government of India
provider.implementedBy: State / UT governments. The student's DOMICILE State/UT awards, verifies and pays the scholarship.

fundingPattern.appliesTo: UTs without a legislature and own grants (e.g. Andaman & Nicobar)

provider.disbursal: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the student's Aadhaar-linked bank account

notProviders.name: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
notProviders.note: Runs separate pre-matric schemes for other categories (e.g. SC/OBC). Not the funder of this ST scheme.

notProviders.name: Ministry of Minority Affairs
notProviders.note: Runs a separate pre-matric scheme for notified minorities. A student cannot hold two scholarships at once.

notProviders.name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
notProviders.note: Only an application / verification / payment-channel portal that some States use. It is NOT a funder.

notProviders.name: School / Institute
notProviders.note: Verifies the application through its Institute Nodal Officer. Does not fund it.

notProviders.name: This platform
notProviders.note: Helps students check eligibility and prepare documents, and helps management verify them. It does not fund or finally award the scholarship.

age.note: The Ministry guidelines set NO minimum or maximum age. A State may add its own rule via stateOverrides.

minimumMarks.renewal: Student must have passed Class IX to renew the scholarship for Class X.
minimumMarks.note: No minimum-percentage requirement for fresh applicants in the Ministry guidelines.

criteria.label: Belongs to a Scheduled Tribe as notified for the State/UT of domicile
Currently studying in Class IX or Class X
Studying in a Government school or a school recognised by the Government or a Central/State Board of Secondary Education
Family income from all sources not more than Rs. 2,50,000 per year (not applicable to an orphan supported by a guardian)
Has a valid account in a Scheduled Bank linked with Aadhaar and mobile number
Has not already received this scholarship for the same class (a repeated class is not paid twice)
For renewal in Class X: passed Class IX

income.definition: Gross income from all sources, without any exemption or deduction allowed under the Income Tax Act.
howCounted: If both father and mother work: combined income of both.
If only one parent is alive: that parent's income only.
Income of any other earning family member (sibling etc.) is NOT included.
Orphan supported by a guardian: income criterion does not apply.

certificate.issuingAuthority: Competent authority notified by the State/UT (set per State in stateOverrides)

appliesTo: Divyangjan (disability certified by competent medical authority)

benefits.renewal: Award continues subject to good conduct and regular attendance; renewed for Class X after passing Class IX.
benefits.note: Rates are from the Ministry guidelines. Some States pay different amounts - use stateOverrides.

text.en: Do you live in a hostel?
text.hi: क्या आप हॉस्टल में रहते हैं?

profileQuestions.effect: Sets benefit rate to hosteller if yes, day scholar if no.

text.en: Do you have a disability, or are you leprosy-cured, or do you have sickle cell anaemia or thalassemia?
text.hi: क्या आपको कोई दिव्यांगता है, या आप कुष्ठ रोग से ठीक हुए हैं, या आपको सिकल सेल एनीमिया या थैलेसीमिया है?

profileQuestions.effect: If yes, the disability_certificate document becomes required and the extra allowance is shown.

questionnaire.resultRule: ELIGIBLE only if every non-skipped knockout question has the answer equal to eligibleAnswer.
questionnaire.onIneligible: Show the failMessage of each failed question in simple language, and suggest other scholarships from the catalog that the student may qualify for. Never silently block.

text.en: Do you belong to a Scheduled Tribe (ST) of the State/UT where you are a permanent resident?
text.hi: क्या आप उस राज्य/केंद्र शासित प्रदेश की अनुसूचित जनजाति (ST) से हैं जहाँ आपका स्थायी निवास है?

failMessage.en: This scholarship is only for Scheduled Tribe (ST) students.
failMessage.hi: यह छात्रवृत्ति केवल अनुसूचित जनजाति (ST) विद्यार्थियों के लिए है।

text.en: Are you studying in Class IX or Class X this year?
text.hi: क्या आप इस वर्ष कक्षा IX या कक्षा X में पढ़ रहे हैं?

failMessage.en: This scholarship is only for Class IX and X. Students in Class XI and above should look at the Post-Matric scholarship.
failMessage.hi: यह छात्रवृत्ति केवल कक्षा IX और X के लिए है। कक्षा XI और उससे ऊपर के विद्यार्थी पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति देखें।

text.en: Is your school a government school, or recognised by the Government or a Central/State Board of Secondary Education?
text.hi: क्या आपका स्कूल सरकारी है, या सरकार या केंद्रीय/राज्य माध्यमिक शिक्षा बोर्ड से मान्यता प्राप्त है?

failMessage.en: The school must be a government school or a recognised school.
failMessage.hi: स्कूल सरकारी या मान्यता प्राप्त होना चाहिए।

text.en: Are you an orphan being looked after by a guardian?
text.hi: क्या आप अनाथ हैं और किसी अभिभावक की देखरेख में हैं?

questions.effect: If yes: skip q_income and do not ask for the income_certificate.

text.en: Is your family's total income from ALL sources (father and mother together, if both earn) Rs. 2,50,000 per year or less?
text.hi: क्या आपके परिवार की सभी स्रोतों से कुल वार्षिक आय (यदि माता-पिता दोनों कमाते हैं तो दोनों की मिलाकर) ₹2,50,000 या उससे कम है?

helpText.en: Count gross income without tax deductions. Income of brothers/sisters or other relatives is not counted.
helpText.hi: आयकर में छूट/कटौती के बिना कुल आय गिनें। भाई-बहन या अन्य रिश्तेदारों की आय नहीं गिनी जाती।

failMessage.en: Family income must not be more than Rs. 2,50,000 per year.
failMessage.hi: परिवार की वार्षिक आय ₹2,50,000 से अधिक नहीं होनी चाहिए।

text.en: Do you (or your parent) have a bank account in your/their name in a Scheduled Bank, linked with Aadhaar and your mobile number?
text.hi: क्या आपके या आपके माता-पिता के नाम पर किसी अनुसूचित बैंक में खाता है जो आधार और मोबाइल नंबर से जुड़ा है?

failMessage.en: You need an active bank account linked to Aadhaar and mobile so the money can be sent by DBT. Please get it linked first.
failMessage.hi: DBT से पैसा भेजने के लिए आधार और मोबाइल से जुड़ा सक्रिय बैंक खाता ज़रूरी है। कृपया पहले खाता लिंक करवाएँ।

text.en: Are you currently receiving any other scholarship?
text.hi: क्या आपको अभी कोई अन्य छात्रवृत्ति मिल रही है?

failMessage.en: A student cannot receive another scholarship together with this one.
failMessage.hi: इस छात्रवृत्ति के साथ कोई अन्य छात्रवृत्ति नहीं ली जा सकती।

text.en: Have you already received this scholarship for the same class you are in now (for example because you are repeating the class)?
text.hi: क्या आप जिस कक्षा में अभी हैं उसी के लिए यह छात्रवृत्ति पहले ले चुके हैं (जैसे कक्षा दोहराने के कारण)?

failMessage.en: The scholarship is paid only once for a class. You can apply again when you are promoted to the next class.
failMessage.hi: एक कक्षा के लिए छात्रवृत्ति केवल एक बार मिलती है। अगली कक्षा में जाने पर आप फिर आवेदन कर सकते हैं।

text.en: Did you receive this scholarship last year in Class IX?
text.hi: क्या आपको पिछले वर्ष कक्षा IX में यह छात्रवृत्ति मिली थी?

questions.effect: If yes (and now in Class X): applicationType = renewal and q_passed_ix is asked. Otherwise applicationType = fresh.

text.hi: क्या आप कक्षा IX में उत्तीर्ण हुए हैं?

failMessage.en: Renewal for Class X needs you to have passed Class IX.
failMessage.hi: कक्षा X के लिए नवीनीकरण हेतु कक्षा IX में उत्तीर्ण होना आवश्यक है।

studentTip.en: Take a flat, well-lit photo of the front. All four corners must be visible.
studentTip.hi: सीधी, अच्छी रोशनी वाली फोटो लें। चारों कोने दिखने चाहिए।

documents.privacy: Store ONLY the last 4 digits of the Aadhaar number. Mask the rest in all UI, logs and exports.

studentTip.en: It must be issued by the competent authority of your State. The community name must be clearly readable.
studentTip.hi: यह आपके राज्य के सक्षम प्राधिकारी द्वारा जारी होना चाहिए। समुदाय का नाम साफ़ पढ़ा जाना चाहिए।

studentTip.en: A self-declaration or affidavit is NOT accepted. It must be issued by the authority your State has notified (for example Tehsildar). Take it once at admission to Class IX; it stays valid for Class X.
studentTip.hi: स्व-घोषणा या शपथपत्र मान्य नहीं है। यह आपके राज्य द्वारा अधिसूचित प्राधिकारी (जैसे तहसीलदार) से होना चाहिए। कक्षा IX के प्रवेश पर एक बार बनवाएँ; यह कक्षा X के लिए भी मान्य रहेगा।

studentTip.en: Must be issued by a competent medical authority of the State/UT.
studentTip.hi: यह राज्य/केंद्र शासित प्रदेश के सक्षम चिकित्सा प्राधिकारी द्वारा जारी होना चाहिए।

studentTip.en: Plain background, face clearly visible, no filters.
studentTip.hi: सादा पृष्ठभूमि, चेहरा साफ़ दिखे, कोई फ़िल्टर नहीं।

label.en: Bank passbook first page (or cancelled cheque)
label.hi: बैंक पासबुक का पहला पन्ना (या कैंसल चेक)

documents.sourceNote: The guidelines require correct bank details (account number, IFSC) in the application. This platform asks for proof so management can cross-check them.

label.en: School ID card or bonafide certificate (shows Class IX/X)
label.hi: स्कूल आईडी कार्ड या बोनाफाइड प्रमाण पत्र (कक्षा IX/X दर्शाता हो)

documents.sourceNote: Lets management confirm current class and school. The school's Institute Nodal Officer also verifies in the real State process.

aiVerification.purpose: Quality and consistency screening only. The AI never approves, rejects or judges authenticity. It only decides whether the student may press Submit.

imageQuality.note: Default thresholds - tune with real phone photos.

perDocumentRules.manualFlag: Management must confirm the community name matches the official ST list of the domicile State.

crossDocumentChecks.note: Fuzzy match, ignore case/spacing/initials, handle Hindi-English transliteration.

studentMessageRules: Messages are short, in the student's language, and say exactly what to fix (for example: 'The photo is blurry. Hold the phone steady and retake.').
Never show raw OCR errors or confidence numbers to the student.
The student can replace a document any number of times before submitting.

checklist: Student category is ST and the ST certificate is genuine, legible and issued by a competent authority
Community name matches the official ST list of the domicile State
Domicile certificate matches the claimed domicile State/UT
Income certificate is from the notified authority, in the correct year, and income is within Rs. 2,50,000 (or student is a certified orphan)
Name, father's name and date of birth are consistent across all documents
School ID / bonafide confirms Class IX or X in a recognised school
Bank account details match the bank proof and the account holder is the student or parent
Disability certificate (if claimed) is from a competent medical authority
No other scholarship declared; not repeating a paid class
rules: A reviewer must open every document and tick every checklist item before Approve is enabled.
Mark Defective or Reject requires a written reason shown to the student.
AI WARN flags are shown next to the relevant document so the reviewer looks at them first.

levels.note: Optional second level (the real process has Institute, then District/State verification). Off by default in the demo.

actions.effect: status -> APPROVED, student profile updated, notification sent
status -> DEFECTIVE, student can fix the listed documents and resubmit
status -> REJECTED with reason (final for this cycle)

manualVerification.auditLog: Every view, decision, reason and timestamp is stored with the reviewer id.

notifications.recipient: Registered mobile number of the student

text.en: Hello {{studentName}}, your application {{applicationId}} for {{scholarshipName}} has been submitted and sent for verification. We will update you soon.
text.hi: नमस्ते {{studentName}}, {{scholarshipName}} के लिए आपका आवेदन {{applicationId}} जमा हो गया है और सत्यापन के लिए भेज दिया गया है। हम जल्द सूचित करेंगे।

text.en: Hello {{studentName}}, your documents for {{scholarshipName}} (application {{applicationId}}) have been verified and your application has been submitted successfully.
text.hi: नमस्ते {{studentName}}, {{scholarshipName}} (आवेदन {{applicationId}}) के आपके दस्तावेज़ सत्यापित हो गए हैं और आपका आवेदन सफलतापूर्वक जमा हो गया है।

text.en: Hello {{studentName}}, your application {{applicationId}} needs a correction: {{reason}}. Please log in, fix it and submit again.
text.hi: नमस्ते {{studentName}}, आपके आवेदन {{applicationId}} में सुधार चाहिए: {{reason}}। कृपया लॉग इन करके ठीक करें और दोबारा जमा करें।

text.en: Hello {{studentName}}, your application {{applicationId}} could not be accepted: {{reason}}. Log in to see details.
text.hi: नमस्ते {{studentName}}, आपका आवेदन {{applicationId}} स्वीकार नहीं किया जा सका: {{reason}}। विवरण के लिए लॉग इन करें।

rules: Never put Aadhaar, income or bank details in a message.
WhatsApp business-initiated messages must use pre-approved templates; the text above is the template body.
Always also show the notification inside the student's account.

consentText.en: I (parent/guardian) allow my child's details and documents to be used only to check and process this scholarship application.
consentText.hi: मैं (माता-पिता/अभिभावक) अपने बच्चे की जानकारी और दस्तावेज़ों का उपयोग केवल इस छात्रवृत्ति आवेदन की जाँच और प्रक्रिया के लिए करने की अनुमति देता/देती हूँ।

stateOverrides.note: The real scheme is run by each State/UT. Portal, deadlines, income-issuing authority, extra documents and even amounts can differ. Admin can add a State block here without touching code.
